# package ree

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec102/ree"
```

Package ree is the Spanish REE profile of IEC 60870-5-102: the type identifications of the private range (128..255) that Spanish fiscal metering ("Protocolo de comunicaciones entre registradores y concentradores", Red Eléctrica de España) assigns, the meaning it gives to the low bits of the integrated totals' quality descriptor and the session procedure (access key and end of session).

None of it is part of IEC 60870-5-102. It is applied only where the caller asks for it: set Profile as iec102.Params.Profile to decode the bodies below, and use [Login](#func-login), [Logout](#func-logout) and [SetTime](#func-settime) on a client. The generic packages never send or expect an REE ASDU on their own.

We hold no REE document. The sources are, as for package iec102: the names the Beckhoff TS650x manual lists for 128..190 (section 4.2, without layouts), the implementations gisce/iec870ree and daiiniel/IEC60870-5-102 (read for comparison only), the test vectors of gisce/iec870ree and the recorded traffic of an Actaris SL762B meter (session start with C\_AC\_NA\_2, read with C\_CI\_NU\_2). docs/iec102/INTEROPERABILITY.md lists each type with its source and confidence.

Typed bodies: [AccessKey](#type-accesskey) (C\_AC\_NA\_2), [Request](#type-request) (C\_FS\_NA\_2, C\_TA\_VC\_2, C\_TA\_VM\_2, C\_RM\_NA\_2, C\_PC\_NA\_2, C\_DF\_NA\_2, C\_CB\_NT\_2, C\_CB\_UN\_2), [SetClock](#type-setclock) (C\_CS\_TA\_2), [TariffInfo](#type-tariffinfo) (M\_TA\_VC\_2, M\_TA\_VM\_2), [ContractedPowers](#type-contractedpowers) (M\_PC\_NA\_2) and [SpecialDays](#type-specialdays) (M\_DF\_NA\_2). Every other REE type stays [iec102.Raw](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec102#Raw).

Type identifications of the REE profile. Names and numbers as listed in the Beckhoff TS650x manual, section 4.2 and 9.1.10 (which marks 128, 130, 131, 144..149, 180, 184..186, 188 with "-"); the extension types 150..163 are named after gisce/iec870ree only.

	RecordDailyBilling  uint8 = 21  // daily billing closures
	RecordContract1     uint8 = 134 // contract I tariff information (135, 136: II, III)

Record addresses of the REE profile (gisce/iec870ree protocol.py, daiiniel/IEC60870-5-102 RegisterDirections); 11, 12 and 21 coincide with the standard list addresses for measurement periods 1 and 2 and daily values (Beckhoff TS650x manual, section 9.1.8).

## Variables

```go
var Profile iec102.Profile = profile{}
```

Profile decodes the REE bodies of this package; set it as iec102.Params.Profile. Types it does not know are left to the standard codec (and so become iec102.Raw).

## Functions

### func Login

```go
func Login(ctx context.Context, c *client.Client, key uint32) error
```

Login starts a session with the access key of the measuring point: C\_AC\_NA\_2 with cause 6 (activation), record address 0, confirmed with cause 7. The recorded traffic (innoWatt log, Actaris SL762B) starts its session this way, and gisce/iec870ree and daiiniel/IEC60870-5-102 do the same.

### func Logout

```go
func Logout(ctx context.Context, c *client.Client) error
```

Logout finishes the session: C\_FS\_NA\_2 with cause 6, confirmed with cause 7 (gisce/iec870ree, which ignores a missing confirmation).

### func Name

```go
func Name(t iec102.TypeID) string
```

Name returns the REE mnemonic of t, or the standard name from iec102.TypeID.String.

### func SetTime

```go
func SetTime(ctx context.Context, c *client.Client, t iec102.TimeB) error
```

SetTime sets the station's clock: C\_CS\_TA\_2 with cause 6, confirmed with cause 7 (gisce/iec870ree set\_datetime).

### type Quality

```go
type Quality iec102.Quality
```

Quality is the integrated total quality descriptor as the REE profile reads it: IV, CA and CY as in the standard (bits 7, 6, 5), and instead of the sequence number VH (bit 4, time verification), MP (bit 3, parameters modified), IN (bit 2, intrusion), AL (bit 1, period incomplete/alarm) and a reserved bit 0. Source: daiiniel/IEC60870-5-102 Qualifier (encoder) and the innoWatt log's labels "iv,ca,cy,vh,mp,in,al,res"; the Beckhoff manual (section 4.25.8) has a sequence number in bits 0-4. The meaning of each REE bit beyond its name is not documented here.

```go
const (
	QualityIV Quality = 0x80
	QualityCA Quality = 0x40
	QualityCY Quality = 0x20
	QualityVH Quality = 0x10
	QualityMP Quality = 0x08
	QualityIN Quality = 0x04
	QualityAL Quality = 0x02
)
```

Bits of the REE quality descriptor.

#### func (Quality) Has

```go
func (q Quality) Has(f Quality) bool
```

Has reports whether all bits of f are set.

### type Request

```go
type Request struct {
	T iec102.TypeID
	// Object selects the block of a C_CB_NT_2 or C_CB_UN_2: 9 totals 1-8,

```

Request is the body of the REE requests whose information object is empty or a time range: C\_FS\_NA\_2, C\_TA\_VC\_2, C\_RM\_NA\_2, C\_PC\_NA\_2, C\_DF\_NA\_2 (nothing), C\_TA\_VM\_2 (From, To) and C\_CB\_NT\_2, C\_CB\_UN\_2 (Object, From, To). Layouts from gisce/iec870ree and, for C\_CB\_NT\_2, daiiniel/IEC60870-5-102.

### type Session

```go
type Session struct {
	// Key is the access key of the measuring point.
	Key uint32
	// OnSetTime receives the time of a C_CS_TA_2; nil ignores it (the
	// request is still confirmed).
	OnSetTime func(t iec102.TimeB)
	// Next handles the ASDUs that are not session requests.
	Next server.Handler

}
```

Session answers the REE session requests on a server: C\_AC\_NA\_2 is confirmed (cause 7) when the key matches and refused with the P/N bit otherwise, C\_FS\_NA\_2 is confirmed and closes the session, C\_CS\_TA\_2 is passed to OnSetTime and confirmed. Every other ASDU goes to Next, or is refused with cause 14 when Next is nil. The server does not make the standard reads depend on an open session.

That a wrong key is answered with the P/N bit is an interpretation: none of our sources shows a refused login.

```

HandleASDU implements server.Handler.

```

### type TariffRecord

```go
type TariffRecord struct {
	Addr                           uint8
	ActiveAbs, ActiveInc           uint32
	ActiveQual                     uint8
	ReactiveIndAbs, ReactiveIndInc uint32
	ReactiveIndQual                uint8
	ReactiveCapAbs, ReactiveCapInc uint32
	ReactiveCapQual                uint8
	Reserved7                      uint32
	Reserved7Qual                  uint8
	Reserved8                      uint32
	Reserved8Qual                  uint8
	MaxPower                       uint32
	MaxPowerTime                   iec102.TimeA
	MaxPowerQual                   uint8
	ExcessPower                    uint32
	ExcessPowerQual                uint8
	Start, End                     iec102.TimeA
}
```

TariffRecord is one information object of M\_TA\_VC\_2 and M\_TA\_VM\_2 (63 octets; layout of gisce/iec870ree M\_TA\_VX\_2 and its test vector): the contract's register address, absolute and incremental energies with their quality descriptors, the maximum demand with its time, the excess power and the start and end of the billing period.
